t: The Sentinel X100 central heating scale inhibitor provides comprehensive protection for all indirect central heating systems, including those containing aluminium. This 1-litre, non-acidic treatment effectively prevents scale and corrosion, which significantly impacts boiler efficiency and heating system performance. The colourless formula works to safeguard against pin-holing, helping to extend the lifespan of central heating installations and reduce ongoing maintenance needs for trade professionals.
b: Suitable For All Indirect Heating Systems
